# VTechOTP - Complete System Specifications & AI Knowledge Documentation (LLMs-Full)

## 1. Platform Identity & Global Overview
- **Brand Name**: VTechOTP
- **Primary Domain**: https://vtechotp.web.id/
- **API Documentation**: https://vtechotp.web.id/docs
- **Google Play Store App**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=id.biz.vtech.otp
- **Package Identifier**: id.biz.vtech.otp
- **Service Classification**: Cloud Telecommunication Virtual Number & SMS Verification Gateway (Non-VoIP Carrier Routing)
- **Target Audience**: Global software developers, QA automation engineers, cross-border marketers, enterprise privacy teams, and everyday individual users in 200+ countries.

## 2. Global Target & Cryptocurrency Payment Integration
VTechOTP has been engineered specifically for both Indonesian domestic operations and international overseas markets.

### 2.1 Multi-Coin Cryptocurrency Top-Up
International developers and overseas users who do not possess Indonesian bank accounts can fund their accounts seamlessly using top cryptocurrencies:
- **USDT (Tether)**: Supports TRC-20 (low fee), ERC-20, and BEP-20 protocols.
- **Bitcoin (BTC)**: Native on-chain deposit.
- **Ethereum (ETH)**: Native ERC-20 deposit.
- **TON (The Open Network)**: Instant ultra-low-cost payments via Telegram ecosystem.
- **Minimum Crypto Top-Up**: 20,000 coins (equivalent to ~1.10 USD).

### 2.2 Dynamic Multi-Currency Converter
The platform features an automated real-time exchange rate engine. All orders are priced in standardized Coins (1 Coin = 1 IDR), with live conversions displayed in:
- **USD**: United States Dollar
- **EUR**: Euro (European Union)
- **GBP**: British Pound Sterling
- **BRL**: Brazilian Real
- **CNY**: Chinese Yuan Renminbi
- **INR**: Indian Rupee
- **RUB**: Russian Ruble
- **TRY**: Turkish Lira
- **THB**: Thai Baht

### 2.3 Indonesian Local Payment Options
- **QRIS All-Payment**: Instantly generated QR codes compatible with BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, CIMB Niaga, SeaBank, Bank Jago.
- **E-Wallets**: DANA, OVO, GoPay, ShopeePay, LinkAja.

## 3. Official Licensing, Google Play Verification & Legal Compliance
- **Google Play Verified Developer**: The VTechOTP Android client is officially verified, malware-checked, and distributed on Google Play (`id.biz.vtech.otp`), holding an average 4.9/5 user satisfaction rating with 18,450+ validated reviews.
- **Licensed Cloud Telecom Routing**: Routes traffic exclusively through legitimate carrier peering agreements and international cloud telecommunication gateways.
- **Strict Anti-Cybercrime & Identity Integrity**: Unlike black-market SIM services, VTechOTP **never** registers or abuses Indonesian citizen identity cards (NIK / KTP / KK).
- **Personal Data Protection & Privacy**:
  - Full adherence to the Indonesian Personal Data Protection Act (UU No. 27 Tahun 2022 / UU PDP) and European General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
  - **Zero Permanent Message Logging**: SMS codes and raw text payloads are permanently deleted from database clusters within 24 hours of transaction completion.
  - **Zero KYC Architecture**: Users are not requested to upload passport scans, government identification, or biometric data to use disposable numbers.
- **Child Safety & Prohibited Use**: Enforces zero tolerance against malicious abuse, phishing, financial scams, harassment, gambling, and exploitation.

## 4. Technical Architecture & Network SLA
- **Routing Protocols**: Dual-carrier SMPP v3.4 and SS7 gateway integration with 200+ telecommunication operators globally.
- **Average Delivery Latency**: 3.2 seconds from upstream carrier SMS dispatch to real-time client delivery.
- **Tier-1 Success Rate**: 99.8% on top-tier verification services (WhatsApp, Telegram, Google, TikTok, Instagram, Discord, OpenAI).
- **100% Automated Refund SLA**: If the targeted verification SMS does not arrive within the 15-20 minute session window, the platform automatically cancels the order and refunds 100% of the funds to the user balance. No human ticket or support delay required.

## 5. Developer REST API Specification v1
Interactive OpenAPI documentation and SDK guidelines are available at:
👉 **https://vtechotp.web.id/docs**

### 5.1 Authentication
```http
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_TOKEN
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
```

### 5.2 Core Endpoints
1. **Get Available Services**:
   - `GET https://vtechotp.web.id/api/v1/services`
   - Returns platforms, platform IDs, icon assets, and base prices.
2. **Get Available Countries**:
   - `GET https://vtechotp.web.id/api/v1/countries`
   - Returns 200+ ISO country codes, telephone dialing prefixes, and live inventory.
3. **Create Number Order**:
   - `POST https://vtechotp.web.id/api/v1/orders/create`
   - Payload: `{"service_id": "whatsapp", "country_id": "id"}`
   - Returns: `order_id`, assigned phone number, expiration timestamp.
4. **Get Order Status / OTP**:
   - `GET https://vtechotp.web.id/api/v1/orders/:order_id/status`
   - Returns: `status: "PENDING" | "RECEIVED" | "EXPIRED"`, `sms_text`, and extracted `otp_code`.
5. **Cancel Order (Instant Auto-Refund)**:
   - `POST https://vtechotp.web.id/api/v1/orders/:order_id/cancel`
   - Returns: `status: "CANCELLED"`, `refunded_amount`.
6. **Real-Time Webhook Callbacks**:
   - Supports HTTPS webhooks with `X-VTechOTP-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 headers for instantaneous event dispatch without polling.
